method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module, the shared rules in another (the s 9 time limit as a regulative rule run by EVALTRACE, and the s 20 (2) bar), the two seats' exported questions in one module each, and a cases file per seat; exported questions take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Family Provision Act 1969 (ACT), A1969-15, Republication No 12 (R12), effective 12 December 2023, last amended by A2023-57, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1969-15.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) Australian Capital Territory, used under CC BY 4.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seats: the family member claiming provision out of a deceased person's estate: the partner, the person in a domestic relationship of 2 or more years, the child, the stepchild, the grandchild or the parent (fpa-claimant.l4)
the beneficiary answering the claim: the individual who takes under the will or on intestacy and whose share bears the provision (fpa-beneficiary.l4)
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: who may apply, the court's gate for an order, the 6-month time limit and extensions, service, variation, where the provision can come from (appointed and distributed property), the administrator's protection, how the order operates, and the beneficiary's side (burden, variation, paying instead)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run fpa-dates.l4 ; l4 run fpa-rules.l4 ; l4 run fpa-claimant.l4 ; l4 run fpa-beneficiary.l4 ; l4 run fpa-cases-claimant.l4 ; l4 run fpa-cases-beneficiary.l4
checks.result: 115 assertions written, 115 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: s 4; s 7 whole; s 8 (1), (2) (s 8 (3) listed); s 9 whole; s 9A (1)-(4); s 10 (1); s 11 (2), (3); s 13 (1) (with (2), (3) in the court's judgment); s 14; s 15 (1); s 16; s 19; s 20; s 21; s 22 (2). Out: ss 1-3, s 8 (4), s 9A (5), s 11 (1), s 12, s 18 (court and trustee machinery) and the amount of provision (the court's discretion). Reasons in NOTES.md.
also_reads: Administration and Probate Act 1929 (ACT) (grants, intestacy rules in part 3A, s 64 notices): no subject in Commons yet
